method: Direct inspection of CT-aligned PNGs, including orthogonal Z/Y/X cards; no ground-truth annotation campaign
observations: Development component 292 and control components 153 and 137 show useful-looking long continuations following visible CT tissue interfaces.

Development core corridor 1934 is a roughly 54-pixel curved connection. Fresh-control core corridor 1123 is a roughly 65-pixel connection along a visible tissue boundary; both exceed the native 21-pixel maximum.
Fresh-control components 106, 109, 129, 176, 205 and 55 show local additions aligned with visible sheet structure in the displayed orthogonal cuts.
Fresh-control component 116 has additions over 18 Z planes. Orthogonal views demonstrate patch extension, but this does not prove all of the same anatomical sheet was recovered.
The full fresh-control overview remains dominated by unchanged foreground and unfilled geometry; this is selective recovery, not a global .20 mask.
cautions: Development component 301 remains ambiguous in a packed fold with alternative-looking CT structure. Components 290 and 333 are crowded/grazing views. Do not present them as certified anatomical successes.
Fresh-control components 13, 81 and 88 attach around fragmented or broad pre-existing foreground; the X/Y cuts are sparse and do not settle sheet identity.
Fresh-control components 8, 9 and 88 span only one Z plane. A single-plane connection is not a reconstructed 3D sheet patch.
Displayed component-centered cards include all nearby additions, not only the named added component.
All 40 risk-first component cards were inspected, but not every one of the 1279 accepted v2 per-plane corridors was individually adjudicated.
Probability is evidence from the same model, not independent anatomy. The neighboring-probability gate rejected zero real proposals in both blocks.
The new stage intentionally uses local evidence instead of the native 3-pixel global radial endpoint restriction. No global wrap-identity certificate is claimed.

An independent package audit initially misclassified one-voxel brush aprons behind anchors as failed two-ended bridges. The control has 52 such attached voxels. The final verifier separately checks their size and exact adjacency to declared anchors; it does not count them as additional bridges.
